name: Center School Summer Learning & Enrichment Program
description_short: Four week program at Center School in Abington for students entering grades 1 to 8 from any school. Mornings bring small group literacy and math instruction; the full day option adds afternoon STEAM enrichment with science, coding, art, fitness and mindfulness.
refund_policy_summary: Written cancellations by June 1, 2026 are refunded minus a 10% fee; no refunds after June 1.
special_needs_notes: Center School serves students with dyslexia, dysgraphia, dyscalculia, auditory processing disorder, ADHD and executive function challenges; it cannot support students who need one to one wraparound behavioral services all day.

sessions.name: Full Day Program (8:30 am to 3:15 pm)
Morning Only Program (8:30 am to 12:15 pm)

notes: 2026: July 6 to 31. Wilson Fundations (grades 1 to 2) and Just Words (grades 3 to 8) in the mornings. $100 off if registered before April 10; program prices are not on the page. Full day students pack lunch. One to one tutoring at extra cost. Late pickup $1 a minute. 2027 not posted yet.
